orgKey.title: Organisation key
orgKey.description: Enrols this browser in your PhishGuard Teams organisation (from POST /v1/admin/orgs).

userLabel.title: User label
userLabel.description: Optional label shown on the dashboard instead of a device code, e.g. an employee id. Leave empty for pseudonymous devices.

reportActions.title: Report what users chose
reportActions.description: Include the user's choice (left / continued / trusted / reported) in warning events.
